display.purpose: Login, onboarding, and major page introductions only.

headline.purpose: Page titles, dialog titles, and high-level empty states.

title.purpose: Cards, panels, subscription plan names, and compact sections.

body.purpose: Product copy, settings, descriptions, and dense UI text.

label.purpose: Buttons, tabs, navigation, form labels, metadata, and controls.

shadows.name: whisper
shadows.purpose: Low tactile lift for primary buttons, active tabs, selected account cards, and small floating states.

shadows.name: elevated
shadows.purpose: Dropdown menus, popovers, and surfaces that must visually clear the app shell.

shadows.name: focus
shadows.purpose: Keyboard focus reinforcement paired with the blue ring.

shadows.name: modal
shadows.purpose: Blocking dialogs and centered account or billing surfaces.

motion.purpose: Button, input, tab, badge, and navigation state transitions.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Dominant product action with pill shape, black fill, white label, and tactile hover lift.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 0.5rem; height: 2.5rem; padding: 0.5rem 1rem; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 9999px; background: hsl(var(--primary, 0 0% 0%)); color: hsl(var(--primary-foreground, 0 0% 100%)); font-family: var(--font-sans, Inter, system-ui, sans-serif); font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: -0.01em; box-shadow: var(--shadow-whisper, 0 3px 6px rgba(0,0,0,.08), 0 2px 4px rgba(0,0,0,.07)); transition: background-color 150ms ease, border-color 150ms ease, color 150ms ease, box-shadow 150ms ease, transform 150ms ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: color-mix(in srgb, hsl(var(--primary, 0 0% 0%)) 92%, transparent); box-shadow: var(--shadow-elevated, 0 10px 20px rgba(0,0,0,.10), 0 3px 6px rgba(0,0,0,.05)); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: var(--shadow-focus, 0 0 0 3px rgba(13,116,206,.18)); } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { pointer-events: none; opacity: .45; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Low-emphasis action for chrome controls, toolbars, and secondary menu actions.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 0.5rem; height: 2.5rem; padding: 0.5rem 1rem; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 9999px; background: transparent; color: hsl(var(--muted-foreground, 220 6% 40%)); font-family: var(--font-sans, Inter, system-ui, sans-serif); font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: -0.01em; transition: background-color 150ms ease, border-color 150ms ease, color 150ms ease, box-shadow 150ms ease; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background: hsl(var(--secondary, 220 18% 96%)); color: hsl(var(--foreground, 220 12% 13%)); } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: var(--shadow-focus, 0 0 0 3px rgba(13,116,206,.18)); }

components.name: Input Field
components.description: Readable product field with white surface, clear stroke, and blue focus ownership.
components.css: .ds-field { display: grid; gap: 0.5rem; color: hsl(var(--foreground, 220 12% 13%)); font-family: var(--font-sans, Inter, system-ui, sans-serif); font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; } .ds-input { height: 2.75rem; width: 100%; border: 1px solid hsl(var(--input, 240 12% 86%)); border-radius: var(--radius-interactive, .875rem); background: hsl(var(--card, 0 0% 100%)); color: hsl(var(--foreground, 220 12% 13%)); padding: 0.5rem 1rem; font-size: 0.9375rem; transition: background-color 150ms ease, border-color 150ms ease, box-shadow 150ms ease, color 150ms ease; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: hsl(var(--muted-foreground, 220 6% 40%)); opacity: .9; } .ds-input:hover { border-color: hsl(var(--border, 225 12% 89%)); } .ds-input:focus-visible { border-color: hsl(var(--ring, 208 88% 43%)); outline: none; box-shadow: var(--shadow-focus, 0 0 0 3px rgba(13,116,206,.18)); } .ds-input:disabled { cursor: not-allowed; opacity: .5; }

components.name: Pill Tabs
components.description: Segmented pill switcher for current versus selectable product states.
components.css: .ds-tabs { display: inline-flex; min-height: 2.75rem; align-items: center; justify-content: flex-start; gap: 0.25rem; overflow-x: auto; border: 1px solid hsl(var(--border, 225 12% 89%)); border-radius: 9999px; background: color-mix(in srgb, hsl(var(--secondary, 220 18% 96%)) 80%, transparent); padding: 0.25rem; color: hsl(var(--muted-foreground, 220 6% 40%)); box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.55); font-family: var(--font-sans, Inter, system-ui, sans-serif); } .ds-tab { border: 0; border-radius: 9999px; background: transparent; color: inherit; padding: 0.5rem 1rem; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: -0.01em; transition: background-color 150ms ease, color 150ms ease, box-shadow 150ms ease; } .ds-tab:hover { color: hsl(var(--foreground, 220 12% 13%)); } .ds-tab:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: var(--shadow-focus, 0 0 0 3px rgba(13,116,206,.18)); } .ds-tab-active { background: hsl(var(--card, 0 0% 100%)); color: hsl(var(--foreground, 220 12% 13%)); box-shadow: var(--shadow-whisper, 0 3px 6px rgba(0,0,0,.08), 0 2px 4px rgba(0,0,0,.07)); }

components.name: Status Badge
components.description: Compact product status chip for plan, runtime, success, warning, and metadata states.
components.css: .ds-badge { display: inline-flex; min-width: 0; max-width: 100%; align-items: center; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; border: 1px solid hsl(var(--border, 225 12% 89%)); border-radius: 9999px; background: hsl(var(--secondary, 220 18% 96%)); color: hsl(var(--secondary-foreground, 220 12% 13%)); padding: 0.25rem 0.625rem; font-family: var(--font-sans, Inter, system-ui, sans-serif); font-size: 0.6875rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.01em; transition: color 150ms ease, background-color 150ms ease, border-color 150ms ease; } .ds-badge:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: var(--shadow-focus, 0 0 0 3px rgba(13,116,206,.18)); }

components.name: Default Card
components.description: Flat contained surface for settings, security, provider, and subscription panels.
components.html:
Runtime status

Gateway and provider state are visible from this panel.
components.css: .ds-card { border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, hsl(var(--border, 225 12% 89%)) 90%, transparent); border-radius: 1.25rem; background: hsl(var(--card, 0 0% 100%)); color: hsl(var(--card-foreground, 220 12% 13%)); padding: 1.5rem; box-shadow: none; font-family: var(--font-sans, Inter, system-ui, sans-serif); } .ds-card h3 { margin: 0 0 0.5rem; font-size: 1.25rem; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1.25; letter-spacing: -0.02em; } .ds-card p { margin: 0; color: hsl(var(--muted-foreground, 220 6% 40%)); font-size: 0.875rem; line-height: 1.5rem; }

components.name: Navigation Item
components.description: Quiet sidebar destination with clear hover and active ownership.
components.html: ProvidersTasks
components.css: .ds-nav { display: grid; gap: 0.25rem; width: 13rem; font-family: var(--font-sans, Inter, system-ui, sans-serif); } .ds-nav-item { display: flex; align-items: center; min-height: 2.5rem; border-radius: var(--radius-interactive, .875rem); padding: 0.5rem 0.75rem; color: hsl(var(--muted-foreground, 220 6% 40%)); text-decoration: none; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: -0.01em; transition: background-color 150ms ease, color 150ms ease, box-shadow 150ms ease; } .ds-nav-item:hover { background: color-mix(in srgb, hsl(var(--secondary, 220 18% 96%)) 70%, transparent); color: hsl(var(--foreground, 220 12% 13%)); } .ds-nav-active { background: hsl(var(--secondary, 220 18% 96%)); color: hsl(var(--foreground, 220 12% 13%)); } .ds-nav-item:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: var(--shadow-focus, 0 0 0 3px rgba(13,116,206,.18)); }

components.name: Account Trigger
components.description: Sidebar account card that is borderless at rest and framed only on hover or open state.
components.css: .ds-account-trigger { display: flex; width: 100%; align-items: center; gap: 0.75rem; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 1.15rem; background: transparent; padding: 0.625rem; color: hsl(var(--foreground, 220 12% 13%)); text-align: left; font-family: var(--font-sans, Inter, system-ui, sans-serif); transition: background-color 150ms ease, border-color 150ms ease, box-shadow 150ms ease; } .ds-account-trigger:hover, .ds-account-trigger[data-state="open"] { border-color: hsl(var(--border, 225 12% 89%)); background: hsl(var(--card, 0 0% 100%)); box-shadow: var(--shadow-whisper, 0 3px 6px rgba(0,0,0,.08), 0 2px 4px rgba(0,0,0,.07)); } .ds-avatar { display: grid; height: 2rem; width: 2rem; place-items: center; border-radius: 9999px; background: hsl(var(--primary, 0 0% 0%)); color: hsl(var(--primary-foreground, 0 0% 100%)); font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 600; } .ds-account-trigger strong { display: block; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: -0.01em; } .ds-account-trigger small { display: block; color: hsl(var(--muted-foreground, 220 6% 40%)); font-size: 0.75rem; }

components.name: Dropdown Menu
components.description: Floating account or command menu with elevated shadow and compact highlighted rows.
components.css: .ds-dropdown { min-width: 14rem; border: 1px solid hsl(var(--border, 225 12% 89%)); border-radius: 0.75rem; background: hsl(var(--popover, 0 0% 100%)); color: hsl(var(--popover-foreground, 220 12% 13%)); padding: 0.375rem; box-shadow: var(--shadow-elevated, 0 10px 20px rgba(0,0,0,.10), 0 3px 6px rgba(0,0,0,.05)); font-family: var(--font-sans, Inter, system-ui, sans-serif); } .ds-dropdown-label { padding: 0.5rem 0.625rem; color: hsl(var(--foreground, 220 12% 13%)); font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; } .ds-dropdown-item { display: flex; width: 100%; align-items: center; gap: 0.5rem; border: 0; border-radius: 0.5rem; background: transparent; padding: 0.5rem 0.625rem; color: inherit; text-align: left; font-size: 0.875rem; transition: background-color 150ms ease, color 150ms ease; } .ds-dropdown-item:hover, .ds-dropdown-item:focus-visible { background: hsl(var(--accent, 228 15% 92%)); color: hsl(var(--accent-foreground, 220 12% 13%)); outline: none; }

components.name: Centered Dialog
components.description: Fixed-size blocking modal for subscription, account, setup, and product decisions.
components.html:
Subscription

Choose a plan and manage the current subscription without leaving the workspace.
components.css: .ds-dialog-frame { display: flex; width: min(calc(100vw - 2rem), 60rem); height: min(calc(100vh - 2rem), 47.5rem); flex-direction: column; overflow: hidden; border: 1px solid hsl(var(--border, 225 12% 89%)); border-radius: 1.5rem; background: hsl(var(--background, 240 11% 95%)); color: hsl(var(--foreground, 220 12% 13%)); box-shadow: 0 25px 50px -12px rgba(0,0,0,.25); font-family: var(--font-sans, Inter, system-ui, sans-serif); } .ds-dialog-frame header { display: flex; align-items: flex-start; justify-content: space-between; gap: 1rem; border-bottom: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, hsl(var(--border, 225 12% 89%)) 70%, transparent); padding: 1.25rem 1.5rem; } .ds-dialog-frame h2 { margin: 0; font-size: 1.125rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: -0.02em; } .ds-dialog-frame button { display: grid; height: 2rem; width: 2rem; place-items: center; border: 0; border-radius: 9999px; background: transparent; color: hsl(var(--muted-foreground, 220 6% 40%)); font-size: 1.25rem; transition: background-color 150ms ease, color 150ms ease; } .ds-dialog-frame button:hover { background: hsl(var(--secondary, 220 18% 96%)); color: hsl(var(--foreground, 220 12% 13%)); } .ds-dialog-frame main { flex: 1; min-height: 0; overflow: auto; padding: 1.5rem; } .ds-dialog-frame p { margin: 0; color: hsl(var(--muted-foreground, 220 6% 40%)); font-size: 0.875rem; line-height: 1.5rem; }

narrative.overview:
MatchaClaw is a restrained desktop product interface: calm neutral surfaces, clear state hierarchy, compact controls, and familiar app-shell patterns. It should feel like a reliable productivity desk where account state, runtime state, subscriptions, providers, agents, plugins, channels, and scheduled tasks are visible without exposing implementation details.

The system is quiet by default. White and cool-gray surfaces carry most screens; black and white primary actions give confidence; blue appears only as focus and operational attention. Login, setup, subscription, and onboarding screens may use deeper atmosphere, but they must still behave like product workflows, not ads.
keyCharacteristics: Compact, task-first density with visible current state.
Cool neutral canvas, white cards, black primary actions, blue focus.
Rounded controls that feel tactile without becoming decorative.
Flat-by-default panels with shadows reserved for hover, popovers, dialogs, and focus.
Product language hides private upstream implementation names.

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Blue is a focus and attention token, not a brand wash; it must not compete with primary actions.

rules.name: The Product Surface Rule
rules.body: App-shell screens stay neutral and task-first; stronger gradients belong only to login, setup, subscription, and onboarding surfaces where the workflow needs visual separation.

rules.name: The No Decoration Type Rule
rules.body: Do not introduce display fonts, marketing-style uppercase blocks, or gradient text. Inter is the system voice.

rules.name: The Flat Rest Rule
rules.body: Resting product surfaces are bordered and tonal, not shadowed; if every card casts a shadow, the hierarchy has failed.

dos: Do keep the app shell calm: cool background, white content surface, fine border, and compact controls.
Do reserve Command Black for the dominant action and Focus Blue for focus or operational attention.
Do show state through text, icon, weight, border, and background together; never rely on color alone.
Do use the existing rounded vocabulary: pill for actions, 0.875rem for inputs, 1.25rem to 2rem for panels.
Do use portals for dropdowns and modal surfaces so they never clip inside scroll containers.
Do keep account, billing, and subscription copy in Matcha product language.
donts: Don't make MatchaClaw look like a SaaS marketing site inside the product.
Don't use decorative glassmorphism, heavy gradients, novelty controls, oversized hero metrics, vague cloud buzzwords, or private upstream implementation names.
Don't let modals, account cards, or billing flows feel like ads.
Don't make the product feel CLI-first, server-admin-first, or like a raw wrapper around backend endpoints.
Don't use gradient text, side-stripe borders, bounce motion, dense nested cards, or repeated identical card grids.
Don't add new visual language for one screen when existing buttons, inputs, tabs, cards, badges, and dropdowns already cover the job.
